# Customer C001's 50.00 CAD credit, made by a journal entry with no bank split.
#
# A bookkeeper who learns whose money a receipt was moves it onto that
# customer: the receivable against itself, one split standing as C001's credit
# and the other taking the amount off the receivable nobody's name was on.
# Every split is on a receivable, and the transaction and both splits give
# their guids so an invoice can spend the credit by them.
#
# What this fixture produces: customer C001, and one CAD transaction whose
# credit split is in a lot of C001's.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_an_unpost_leaves_a_journal_entry_whole.py.
customer "C001"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD

2026-01-06 * "Attributed to Acme"
	guid: "a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable -50.00 CAD
		guid: "b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1"
		lot_owner: customer:C001
	Assets:Accounts Receivable 50.00 CAD
		guid: "c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1"
